raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
1. Product: BAP.ai
Led the design and implementation of BAP.ai, a SaaS AI platform delivering multichannel virtual agents integrated with GPT-4o, o3-mini.
Developed an automated pipeline for IT support ticket analysis to classify SLA breach reasons and generate human-readable breach explanations using a reasoning-based model.
Designed to handle cost-associated tickets, the system identifies whether a ticket breached its resolution time.
For breached tickets, it intelligently extracts the root cause (breach reason) and provides detailed, contextual explanations to aid in resolution and process improvement.
2. Built RAG-powered platform for oldest operating chemical & pharma company using LangChain and OpenAI
Developed an interactive Q&A chatbot leveraging Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to interpret queries from the Merck Manual.
Designed and implemented LangChain-based architecture integrating OpenAI’s GPT-3.5, Faiss vector store, and custom prompt chains for accurate medical information retrieval.
Enabled similarity-based retrieval of domain-specific biomedical knowledge using Faiss and chunked embeddings of processed documents.
Built an intuitive Streamlit UI for researchers and clinicians to query the Merck Manual in natural language and receive evidence-backed insights.
3. Chat Summarization Model for Customer Support
Designed and implemented a chat summarization solution to assist support agents in quickly understanding customer issues without manually reviewing lengthy chat histories.
Leveraged Azure OpenAI services with advanced prompt engineering to generate concise, context- aware summaries of multi-turn conversations.
Optimized the model to ensure summaries captured critical details (customer intent, key issues, and prior resolutions), reducing average agent handling time and improving ticket resolution accuracy.
Integrated the model within the support ticketing workflow, enhancing agent productivity and improving customer experience.
1. Internal Project
Built automated NLP pipeline for TTUS email classification, processing 200K+ emails monthly with 87% accuracy, enabling 2K/day ticket creation.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and Intel OpenVINO for production ML deployments, reducing deployment time by 50%.
Contributed to AI CoE initiatives on IoT anomaly detection and chatbot frameworks.
Mentored junior engineers.
2. Client: Sennheiser

The purpose of Device Simulator is to test Sennheiser applications like Wireless System Manager and Control Cockpit, which provides professional software solutions for remotely monitoring and controlling Sennheiser’s wireless devices on a single screen.
